integrity: Complete executable integer-mask enumeration, independent graph realization and replayable adaptive-tree and graph-isomorphism certificates. No independent audit performed.
scientific_limitations: One finite canonical graph, ordinary minimum dominating sets, exact finite enumeration and mod-two rather than integral homology. Historical priority can be affected by unindexed results; the 2019 issue has no exact public day.
title: Exact static and adaptive shattering of minimum dominating sets in the Desargues graph
